messages:
jordan: Heads-up — postmortem for INC-2026-042 is merged. We need to lock owners for follow-ups: SLO retarget, dashboard alerts, autoscale/playbook, and a longer-term mitigation for the GPU queue pattern. Who can take what?

maria: I can own the dashboard + alert rules and the error‑budget dashboard. ETA end of week? :white_check_mark:

sam: I’ll take the SLO/SLA proposal, coordinate with product and legal. Can draft a proposal by Tue next week.

lee: I’ll own autoscale/playbook & runbook edits. Need ~2 weeks to implement + dry‑run in staging.

ankur: I’ll validate the recurring GPU queue regex and run the data query. I’ve seen similar bursts on 3 previous incidents — will post logs.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 archived. Summary: transient latency spike traced to KVCACHE eviction during model warmup; p95 and p99 breached for ~18m.

jordan: @maria please include metrics: p50,p95,p99, request rate, backend queue depth, and error budget burn rate. Also include a change to surface request routing (hosted -> dedicated) during high burn.

maria: Will do. Proposing alert: if p95 > 250ms for 10m AND burn_rate > 1.5 then page on-call and create a #runbook channel. Draft of alert rule attached: 
```json
{
  "name": "p95_latency_high_and_burn",
  "condition": "p95_latency > 250ms AND burn_rate > 1.5 for 10m",
  "runbook": "Open #runbook-INC-2026-042, notify oncall and actions for routing fallback"
}
```

sam: For SLA/contract language, I recommend adding a recovery window clause (p95 must return under threshold within 15m) and an explicit fallback policy to route to dedicated capacity at 80% error budget burn. I'll draft wording and tag product legal.

lee: Autoscale thresholds I propose: scale-up if queue_depth > 400 for 5m OR p95>220ms for 3m, plus a soft cap for burst protection. I’ll add manual fallback steps to the runbook. Tagging @oncall_rotation for a review pass.

jordan: Action tracker assignment (putting here so we have a canonical mapping):
- maria: dashboard + alerts (INC2026-042‑dash) — ETA EOW
- sam: SLO/SLA wording & product sync (INC2026-042‑slo) — draft Tue
- lee: autoscale + runbook (INC2026-042‑autoscale) — 2w
- ankur: GPU queue validation + long-term mitigation proposal (INC2026-042‑gpu) — Fri

ankur: Running queries now, will paste a short heatmap and the candidate mitigation (shard balancing + backpressure limiter) in #eng-runtime by EOD Fri.

maria: Created dashboard PR: https://internal.redwood/dash/PR-789 — added owner @maria, test queries and a smoke test. Please review.

sam: Sync scheduled with product Wed 10:00 to align SLA language and customer-facing wording.

jordan: Thanks — lets run a 15min quick sync every Thu at 09:00 until all actions are closed. I’ll update the postmortem with these owners and link the tracking issues. Marking this thread as the canonical tracking thread. :spiral_calendar_pad:

lee: Noted. Will drop a short checklist in the runbook PR so the on-call rotation can practice the fallback run.

maria: Will follow up with PR reviews and wire up alert test harness.

jordan: Great — closing the loop here. If anything slips, call it out in this thread and I’ll escalate.
